title: Page 7
content_zh:
「呃——」看他的表情，不会是在吃醋吧？弯扬的嘴里挂上甜如蜜的笑。「他只不过是……」
「顺道来探病？不要把我当三岁小孩，那个阵仗，说是纯粹来探病，鬼都不信！」
「对，那些神经学权威医生，的确是他特地请来的。」既然他都猜到了，她也不隐瞒他。「我不管他是芳为了什么原因这么做，他们是医生帮病人医病，我们付医药费，就这么简单。」
事实上，母亲有偷偷跟她说，沈嘉雄是因为想弥补两年前「抛弃」她对她的亏欠，才会积极联络熟识的神经学权威医生，一同来她哥哥的病房「探病」。
她想，尚勇不会没猜到这个原因，心照不宣，点到为止，对他们两人比较好。
「医药费，由我来出。」他绝不能让那家伙「专美」于前。
「你已经出了。」她的月薪就是呀！
「那点钱怎么够？」谁知道那家伙有没有隐藏什么心机，比如医好她哥哥，要她陪他一辈子的鬼心机，他可不能不防。
他出钱，那家伙出力。如贝儿所言，他们付钱请他们一群医生医治保俊，功成后，互不相欠，若是敢越线，他一定一脚踹死他！
「都依你。」这种非常「敏感」时刻，他说什么她都点头，他就会心花怒放，不再生闷气。
「好。那我们去吃饭。」他拉着她往门的方向走。
「尚勇，我们才刚吃完晚餐回来。」美眸惊瞠，他该不会得了健忘症吧？
「是没错，可是，我没有吃饱。」
「刚才你说……你吃不下了。」
「气消了，突然又觉得饿。」
「呃……」真是被他打败了。
她觉得好气又好笑，既然他饿了，那她这个「全职保母」当然得赶快带他去吃饭。
「走吧。」换她走在前拉着他，可走没两步，就又被他拉回，整个人挂入他怀里。
「怎么了？你不是饿了？我带你去吃饭。」干么停下不走了？
氤氲清欲的黑眸凝视她，低哑声逸出内心渴望。「一整个下午没吻你，我现在其实比较想吃你。」

不等她的允许，他俯首，一记热吻火速落下，他像一头饥饿的野狼，大口啃吮着现成的美味餐点，狼吞虎咽，似不将她全身上下吃乾抹净，绝不罢休。
外出用餐，晚点再说。
第10章(1)
掌家二少掌尚仁从希腊回来，他和掌尚勇在总裁办公室似乎在商量什么事，保贝儿不便在场，早上又没重要的事，她遂请了假，到医院去探望哥哥。
哥哥和往常一样，除了手指偶尔动一下，依旧躺在病床上不动。但医生们都抱持乐观态度，这让她和母亲对哥哥的复原更有信心。
沈嘉雄凑巧也在场，她待了一会儿，以准备回公司处理下午的工作为籍口想提早离开，沈嘉雄却约她吃午餐，说有事要跟她说。
她想，一起吃个午餐又没什么，正好可以籍机跟他把话说清楚。
「你不是有话要跟我说？」他们到附近一家餐厅用餐，坐了一会儿，他一直低头没出声，她想先听听他要说的是什么。
「贝儿，我……」沈嘉雄轻摇着杯中水，满面歉意。「我要先向你道歉……」
「如果是两年前的事，那就不用了。」察觉自己的口气冲了点，她深吸了一口气，缓和情绪，「你向我道歉的次数够多了。」
当时他至少说了两百次的「对不起」，那又如何？她的心依旧很痛、泪水依旧狂流，对当时的她而言，那句话只是一个无用的名词。
「我很感谢你帮我哥哥，但……」她顿了下，喝口水，犹豫着接下来的话该怎么说。
说不管哥哥能不能复原，她以后都不想再见到他？还是说她已经有男朋发，要他别来干扰她？
这么说似乎有点绝情，况且，若他帮哥哥，除了弥补她之外，并没有其他意思呢？
「我知道，我不会给你带来任何困扰的。」沈嘉雄推了推眼镜，淡淡一笑。「我纯粹……只是想弥补你。」
听他这么说，她反倒觉得不好意思。他其实非常好，交往期间对她也非常体贴，只是身为独子的他，不得不听母命，娶一个门当户对的妻子。
「你，结婚了吧？」
「已经订婚，还没结婚。」
「哦。」虽然恨过、痛过、哭过，但那都是过去式了，现在的她，很愿意祝他幸福。
「你呢？」

「我？我还没嫁人。」
「我知道，我是想问……贝儿，听好。我没恶意，但是，你是不是和掌家三少在交往？」他问过朋友，掌尚勇可是天信集团的小开，现在还代理总裁一职，掌家的家世比起他家有过之，他很担心贝儿会「重蹈覆辙」。
她没回答，只是静静看着他，他期期艾艾地似乎想跟她说什么。
「我……我很希望你幸福，但是，你见过掌尚勇的父母了吗？他们……愿意让你当掌家媳妇吗？」
他的话，如当头棒喝般将她打醒。
和尚勇在一起，她从没想过这个问题。或许有，只是她不愿意去面对，她沉溺在和他谈情的喜悦中，认定两人会这么一直甜蜜下去，没有去想其他的……
「贝儿，对不起，但我必须提醒你，因为我不希望你再次受伤害。」
「谢谢你，我很好。」她强装坚强，手却微徽发抖。
她怎会没想到这一点？
两年前她才被重重伤过一回，伤口才刚痊愈，难道自己就忘了痛？
她深知这回和两年前不同，她和沈嘉雄的恋情属细水长流型，他斯文体贴，她温柔乖巧，如果缘份够，他们会是牵手平平凡凡过一辈子的夫妻。
可她和尚勇的恋情不同，他们两人爱得狂热，她不敢想像没有他的日子，她一个人要如何撑下去？
「我相信尚勇是个很有担当的人。」她这么安慰着自己。
「那就好。」他脸色有些不自在。
她无意说话伤他，但是，此刻她脑里只想着掌尚勇，她想听他亲口告诉她，他的父母不会反对他们交往，他不会抛弃她。
「对不起，我……我有事先走。」神情恍惚起身，心中充斥着不确定感，令她心慌。
「贝儿……」沈嘉雄付完帐，追了出去，「你还好吧？」
「我、我要回公司。」
见她六神无主，一副失措样，他很是担心。「我送你去。」
没有拒绝，她点头。

拦了计程车，他扶她上车，后头一辆跑车的驾驶者亲眼目睹这一幕，眼里喷着怒火——
他特地开着跑车来医院找她，想告诉她一个「好消息」，未料，却让他看到她和旧爱藕断丝连这一幕，怒极的他。踩足油门，超越他们搭的计程车，狂奔而去。
===================================================================
「你问我你的总裁去哪里？我还想问你，我的小弟人在何方？」刚回台湾的掌尚仁，坐在总裁办公室和保贝儿大眼瞪小眼。
「那个人」明明答应他要继续当代理总裁直到大哥回来接手为止，念在他这么情义相挺的份上，他也答应今天到下班之前帮他坐镇「一下子」，让他去办要事，不只如此，他还跟他借了跑车出去。
可是下班时间已过了三个钟头，「那个人」还没回来，他还苦命的在总裁办公室里批阅会文，等不到爱车回来不打紧，他的爱妻可是还在等他回去吃晚餐，如果他再晚一个钟头回去，他保证自己一定会吃到史上无敌辣的「酸辣汤」。
content_en:
"Uh-" Looking at his expression, he couldn't be jealous, could he? A smile as sweet as honey hung on his crooked mouth. "He's just..."
"Drop in to visit a doctor? Don't treat me like a three-year-old child. I won't believe it if I say I'm just here to visit a doctor!"
"Yes, those authoritative neurological doctors were indeed specially invited by him." Since he had guessed it, she didn't hide it from him. "I don't care why he did it. They are doctors who treat patients. We pay the medical bills. It's that simple."
In fact, her mother secretly told her that it was because Shen Jiaxiong wanted to make up for his debt to her for "abandoning" her two years ago that she actively contacted an authoritative neurologist she was familiar with and came to her brother's ward to "visit" him.
She thought that Shang Yong would not have guessed the reason, and tacitly agreed that it would be better for them both.
"I will pay for the medical expenses." He would never let that guy "beautiful" come before him.
"You're already out." That's her monthly salary!
"How can that little money be enough?" Who knows if that guy has any hidden agenda, such as curing her brother and asking her to stay with him for the rest of his life. He has to be on guard against it.
He put in the money, the guy put in the effort. As Belle said, they paid a group of doctors to treat Baojun. After the success, they didn't owe each other anything. If he dared to cross the line, he would definitely kick him to death!
"It's all up to you." At this very "sensitive" moment, if she nods her head no matter what he says, he will be happy and no longer sulky.
"Okay. Then let's go eat." He pulled her toward the door.
"Shang Yong, we just came back from dinner." The beautiful eyes were shocked. Could he be suffering from amnesia?
"That's right, but I haven't eaten enough."
"Just now you said...you can't eat anymore."
"The anger subsided, and suddenly I felt hungry again."
"Uh..." He was really defeated.
She felt angry and funny. Since he was hungry, of course she, the "full-time nanny", had to take him to eat quickly.
"Let's go." She walked forward and pulled him, but after only two steps, he pulled her back again, and her whole body was hung in his arms.
"What's wrong? Aren't you hungry? I'll take you to eat." Why didn't you stop?
Black eyes full of lust stared at her, and his inner desire escaped in a low voice. "I haven't kissed you all afternoon. I actually want to eat you more now."
Without waiting for her permission, he bowed his head and kissed her passionately. He was like a hungry wild wolf, gnawing at the delicious ready-made meal and devouring it, as if he would not stop until he ate her whole body.
Eat out, talk about it later.
Chapter 10(1)
The second young master of the family, Shangren, came back from Greece. He and Shangyong seemed to be discussing something in the president's office. Bao Beier couldn't be present and there was nothing important to do in the morning, so she asked for leave and went to the hospital to visit her brother.
My brother was as usual, lying motionless on the hospital bed except for the occasional movement of his fingers. But doctors are optimistic, giving her and her mother more confidence in her brother's recovery.
Shen Jiaxiong happened to be present. She stayed for a while and wanted to leave early on the pretext of going back to the company to handle the afternoon work. However, Shen Jiaxiong invited her to lunch and said he had something to tell her.
She thought it would be okay to have lunch together, and it would be a good opportunity to talk clearly to him.
"Don't you have something to tell me?" They went to a nearby restaurant to dine and sat for a while. He kept his head down and said nothing. She wanted to hear what he had to say first.
"Belle, I..." Shen Jiaxiong gently shook the water in the glass with an apology on his face. "I want to apologize to you first..."
"If it happened two years ago, then there's no need." Realizing that her tone was a bit harsh, she took a deep breath to calm down, "You've apologized to me enough times."
He said "I'm sorry" at least two hundred times at that time, so what? Her heart was still in pain and her tears were still flowing wildly. She felt so sorry for that time.To her, that sentence was just a useless noun.
"I'm very grateful to you for helping my brother, but..." She paused, took a sip of water, and hesitated on what to say next.
Saying that no matter whether her brother can recover or not, she never wants to see him again? Or is it that she already has a boyfriend and wants him not to interfere with her?
It seems a bit desperate to say this. Besides, what if he helps his brother and has no other meaning besides making up for her?
"I know, I won't cause you any trouble." Shen Jiaxiong pushed up his glasses and smiled lightly. "I purely...just want to make it up to you."
She felt embarrassed to hear what he said. He was actually very nice and was very considerate to her during their relationship. However, as an only son, he had to obey his mother's orders and marry a well-matched wife.
"Are you married?"
"Already engaged, not married yet."
"Oh." Although she had hated, hurt, and cried, those were all in the past tense. Now, she was willing to wish him happiness.
"What about you?"
"Me? I'm not married yet."
"I know, I want to ask... Belle, listen. I don't mean any harm, but are you dating the third young master of the business owner?" He asked his friend. Zhang Shangyong was a junior member of the Tianxin Group, and he is still the acting president. The business owner's family background was worse than his, and he was worried that Belle would "make the same mistake again."
She didn't answer, just looked at him quietly, and he seemed to want to say something to her.
"I... I hope you are happy, but have you met Zhang Shangyong's parents? Are they... willing to let you be the wife of the family leader?"
His words woke her up like a wake-up call.
With Shang Yong, she never thought about this problem. Maybe there was, but she didn't want to face it. She was immersed in the joy of falling in love with him, convinced that the two of them would be sweet forever, and didn't think about anything else...
"Belle, I'm sorry, but I have to remind you because I don't want you to get hurt again."
"Thank you, I'm fine." She pretended to be strong, but her hands were shaking slightly.
How could she not have thought of this?
She was seriously injured just two years ago, and the wound had just healed. Did she forget the pain?
She knew that this time was different from two years ago. Her relationship with Shen Jiaxiong was of a long-term nature. He was gentle and considerate, and she was gentle and well-behaved. If they were destined to be together, they would be a couple holding hands and living an ordinary life.
But her relationship with Shang Yong was different. The two of them loved each other passionately. She couldn't imagine a life without him. How could she survive alone?
"I believe Shang Yong is a very responsible person." She comforted herself.
"That's good." He looked a little uncomfortable.
She didn't mean to hurt him with her words, but at the moment, she only thought about Zhang Shangyong. She wanted to hear him tell her personally that his parents would not object to their relationship and that he would not abandon her.
"I'm sorry, I...I have to leave first." She stood up in a daze, her heart filled with uncertainty, which made her panic.
"Belle..." Shen Jiaxiong paid the bill and chased out, "Are you okay?"
"I-I want to go back to the company."
He was very worried when he saw her confused and confused. "I'll take you there."
Not refusing, she nodded.
After stopping the taxi, he helped her get into the car. The driver of a sports car behind him witnessed this scene with his own eyes, his eyes filled with anger——
He specially drove a sports car to the hospital to find her, wanting to tell her "good news." Unexpectedly, he saw the scene where she was disconnected from her old love, and he was extremely angry. He stepped on the accelerator, passed the taxi they took, and ran away.
===================================================================
"You asked me where your CEO is? I also want to ask you, where is my little brother?" Just returned to TaiwanMr. Shangren, sitting in the CEO's office, stared at Bao Beier with big eyes.
"That person" clearly promised him to continue to be the acting president until his elder brother came back to take over. Because of his support, he also promised to help him "for a while" before getting off work today and let him do important things. Not only that, he also borrowed a sports car from him.
But it was already three hours after get off work, and "that person" hadn't come back yet. He was still working hard in the president's office reviewing documents. It didn't matter if he couldn't wait until his car came back, but his beloved wife was still waiting for him to go back for dinner. If he went back an hour later, he guaranteed that he would have the most spicy "hot and sour soup" in history.
